titleEn: Commercial Warehouse Door Renovation in Burnaby 2026: Cost, BC Code Requirements and What to Expect
titleZh: 本拿比商业仓库门装修2026：费用、BC省规范及注意事项
contentEn:
A commercial warehouse door renovation in Burnaby costs between $1,800 and $7,500, depending on whether the work is limited to a door frame repair and repaint or involves full drywall replacement and structural reinforcement. The most common scope — replacing damaged drywall around the entrance, applying a commercial-grade paint finish, and reinforcing the door frame to meet BC Fire Code requirements — typically falls in the $3,000–$5,000 range and completes within one week, done during off-peak hours so daily operations are not interrupted.

Reno Stars has completed warehouse entrance renovations in Burnaby, Richmond and Vancouver for industrial facilities, retail back-of-house spaces and manufacturing facilities. The project described below is representative of what a Burnaby industrial client can expect.

What Does a Commercial Warehouse Door Renovation Cover?

A warehouse entrance renovation goes beyond swapping out a door. In Burnaby's industrial districts — including Gilmore, Brentwood and Hastings — building inspectors and fire marshals regularly flag damaged door frames, compromised drywall and inadequate fire-rated seals under the BC Building Code. The scope that satisfies both appearance and compliance includes:

  • Removal and replacement of damaged or mold-affected drywall within 1.2 m of the door opening
  • Reinforcing the door frame to BC Building Code Section 9.1 requirements for fire-rated assemblies
  • Application of a commercial-grade paint (minimum opacity 85%, washability rating GS-11 or equivalent)
  • Sealant and weatherstripping replacement to maintain thermal envelope compliance

BC Code Requirements for Warehouse Entrances in Burnaby

Under the BC Building Code 2024, any commercial entrance in a fire-separated assembly must maintain its fire-resistance rating. That means the door frame, the surrounding wall assembly and all penetrations (electrical, plumbing) must be reviewed by a registered fire protection engineer if the wall is part of a rated corridor or occupancy separation. For most warehouse entrance upgrades in Burnaby — where the entrance wall is not a rated assembly — a professional renovation that replaces damaged materials and applies commercial-grade finishes is sufficient to pass a City of Burnaby inspection.

The City of Burnaby requires a building permit for any work that modifies the structural components of a commercial entrance. Work limited to painting and drywall repair may qualify for an expedited permit if it does not alter the fire rating of the assembly.

Timeline: How Long Does a Warehouse Door Renovation Take?

The fastest turnaround for a complete warehouse entrance renovation — drywall replacement, frame reinforcement and commercial paint — is four to five working days. More complex scopes involving structural engineer review or Heritage status (some Burnaby industrial buildings are pre-1940) can extend to three weeks. A renovation done during off-peak hours — evenings, weekends or between shift changes — avoids disrupting facility operations entirely.

Permit processing with the City of Burnaby typically takes three to five business days for a standard commercial renovation permit, and inspections are scheduled within two business days of completion notification.

Before and After: What Changes on the Door and Surrounding Wall

Visual impact matters in industrial leasing and insurance assessments. A freshly painted entrance with reinforced framing projects operational professionalism to visitors, insurers and prospective tenants.

How Much Does a Warehouse Door Renovation Cost in Metro Vancouver 2026?

Costs in the Lower Mainland reflect local labour rates and material pricing. A typical breakdown:

ScopeEstimated Cost Range
Door frame repair + commercial repaint$1,800 – $3,200
Drywall replacement + frame reinforcement$3,000 – $5,000
Full entrance rebuild + fire-code compliance$5,500 – $7,500
City of Burnaby building permit$250 – $600
Fire engineer review (if required)$800 – $1,500

These figures reflect 2026 Metro Vancouver commercial construction rates. Final cost depends on facility access constraints, after-hours surcharges and whether the wall assembly is fire-rated.

Choosing a Contractor for Warehouse Renovations in Burnaby

A commercial contractor working in Burnaby industrial spaces must carry a minimum of $2 million general liability insurance, have experience with City of Burnaby permit processes and understand BC Building Code Section 9.1 fire separation requirements. Ask for proof of Workers Compensation Board of BC coverage and references from comparable industrial projects in the Lower Mainland.

Frequently Asked Questions

Does a warehouse door renovation in Burnaby need a building permit?

Yes, if the work modifies the structural components of the entrance or affects a fire-rated assembly. Painting and drywall repair alone may qualify for an expedited permit. The City of Burnaby issues commercial renovation permits within three to five business days.

What BC Building Code section governs warehouse entrance fire separations?

BC Building Code 2024, Section 9.1, covers fire separations in residential and commercial buildings. A fire protection engineer must review if the entrance wall is part of a rated corridor, occupancy separation or firewall.

How long does a typical warehouse door renovation take?

A standard scope — drywall replacement, frame reinforcement and commercial paint — completes in four to five working days when done during off-peak hours. Complex scopes involving structural engineer review can take three weeks.

Can a warehouse entrance renovation be done without shutting down operations?

Yes. Working during off-peak hours — evenings, weekends or between shift changes — allows the renovation to proceed without interrupting daily operations. This approach is common in Burnaby's industrial districts.

What is the cost range for a commercial warehouse entrance renovation in Metro Vancouver in 2026?

A door frame repair and repaint costs $1,800–$3,200. A full scope with drywall replacement and fire-code compliance costs $5,500–$7,500, plus permit and engineering fees. Rates reflect current Metro Vancouver commercial construction pricing.

商业仓库门装修包括哪些内容？

仓库入口装修不仅仅是更换一扇门。在本拿比的工业区域——包括Gilmore、Brentwood和Hastings——建筑检查员和消防官员经常指出破损的门框、损坏的石膏板和不符合BC建筑规范的消防密封件。满足外观和合规双重要求的工程范围包括：

  • 拆除并更换门洞1.2米范围内的损坏或发霉石膏板
  • 按照BC建筑法第9.1节防火等级组件要求加固门框
  • 涂刷商业级涂料（遮盖率最低85%，耐洗性达到GS-11或同等标准）
  • 更换密封胶和门窗密封条，以保持热封合规

BC省规范对本拿比仓库入口的要求

根据2024年BC建筑法，任何商业入口的防火隔离墙必须保持其耐火等级。这意味着门框、周围墙板和所有穿透件（电气、管道）如果属于耐火走廊或占用分隔的一部分，必须由注册消防工程师审查。对于本拿比的大多数仓库入口改造——入口墙不属于耐火组件——更换损坏材料并涂刷商业级饰面的专业改造足以通过本拿比市政府的检查。

本拿比市政府要求对任何修改商业入口结构部件的工程申请建筑许可证。如果工程不改变耐火等级，仅限油漆和石膏板维修的工程可能有资格获得快速许可。

工期：仓库门装修需要多长时间？

完整的仓库入口装修——石膏板更换、框架加固和商业涂料——最快可在四至五个工作日内完成。涉及结构工程师审查或遗产认定（本拿比一些工业建筑建于1940年前）的更复杂工程可能延长至三周。在非高峰时段——晚间、周末或轮班之间——进行的装修完全可以避免中断设施运营。

常见问题

本拿比仓库门装修需要申请建筑许可证吗？

需要，如果工程修改了入口的结构部件或影响耐火组件。仅限油漆和石膏板维修的工程如有资格获得快速许可。本拿比市政府通常在三至五个工作日内签发商业装修许可证。

BC省建筑法中哪一条规定仓库入口的防火分隔？

2024年BC建筑法第9.1节涵盖住宅和商业建筑的防火分隔。如果入口墙属于耐火走廊、占用分隔或防火墙的一部分，消防工程师必须进行审查。

典型的仓库门装修需要多长时间？

仓库入口装修能否在不停产的情况下进行？
